title: ctenitis grisebachii
intro: Ctenitis grisebachii, commonly known as the Grey Spleenwort or Rigid Fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. It is native to the tropical regions of Central and South America, where it is often found growing in shaded, humid environments. The Grey Spleenwort has been used in traditional medicine to treat a variety of health issues, including inflammation, fever, and respiratory problems, due to its reported health benefits and therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties. The bioactive constituents of Ctenitis grisebachii include flavonoids, terpenoids, and saponins, which are believed to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
